title: sheaf descent / sheafification of the phantom presheaf on Spec Z
exec_note: Run off-mount in /tmp per [[aps-run-sync-hazard]]; report written back via Windows-path Write tool. Verifies: (a) coker(Delta: Z -> Z^S) is free of rank |S|-1 via Smith normal form (|S|=2..6); (b) the product presheaf F(S)=prod_p Z_p satisfies descent over the singleton prime cover; (c) the sheafification comparison P(S) ->> L(S) has kernel Z^{|S|-1}; (d) rad-lattice meets/joins = gcd/lcm of radicals (restriction/glueing). The set-theoretic part (ii) of Pass 61 (b=aleph_1 => phantom nonzero) is a literature citation, not machine-checkable.
